Prebuild in isolated /tmp copy exits 0 with 'Finished prebuild'. Generated Info.plist has all 6 Facebook keys (FacebookAppID=2826139691089206, FacebookClientToken 32 chars sha256:f6583583, FacebookDisplayName=meemz, AutoInit=true, AutoLogAppEvents=true, AdvertiserIDCollection=false), CFBundleURLSchemes contains fb2826139691089206, LSApplicationQueriesSchemes has all 4 (fbapi, fb-messenger-api, fbauth2, fbshareextension), exactly 2 SKAdNetworkIdentifier entries injected. Podfile contains 'use_native_modules!' on line 42 which will autolink react-native-fbsdk-next. app.config.js resolves to 6 plugins under production env (metaAppEventsConfigured=true) and 5 plugins under baseline (metaAppEventsConfigured=false). Regression: Metro 200, /api/memes 200 (list, 20 items), /api/auth/register 422 on empty body (validates payload). git diff HEAD~1 HEAD shows exactly 1 file changed (frontend/app.json, +1 -1). No files modified during testing; tmp prebuild dir cleaned up.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Fix verified end-to-end for FB Events Manager tracking. Next real signal will come from live TestFlight builds sending AppEventsLogger events to Meta Events Manager after IPA install on device. Local verification cannot simulate device install; user must ship a new TestFlight build (>=1.0.17) and confirm events appear.
rca_of_issue: PRIOR RCA (confirmed): expo-splash-screen plugin referenced './assets/images/splash-icon.png' but the file on disk is 'splash-image.png'. The ios.dangerous mod chain runs SEQUENTIALLY — the splash-screen mod threw ENOENT before the FB Info.plist mod could run, aborting the whole chain, so no FB keys were persisted, and FBSDK pod was never autolinked. Shipped IPA had 0 FB events. FIX: single-character typo correction in app.json line 44. Verified prebuild now completes and Info.plist contains all FB keys.
